project.title: Wastewater sequencing using metagenomics and epicPCR
project.description: We applied long-read metagenomic sequencing (ONT MinION), short-read metagenomic sequencing (BGI DNBSeq), and epicPCR on wastewater samples collected from a full-scale WWTP from Houston, TX, USA. EpicPCR targeted sul1, ermB, and tetO. EpicPCR amplicons were sequenced using ONT MinION.
project.center_name: Wastewater surveillance sequencing data for Houston, Texas, 2021
